purpose: Rust parser and lifecycle fixture coverage manifest for Polymarket adapter parity gates.

fixture_groups.product_scope: Gamma market, event, tag, search, slug, and filter discovery for Polymarket binary outcome instruments
covers: Gamma market response parsing into BinaryOption instruments
sports market fee schedules and game metadata
event, tag, search, slug, and filter discovery
missing instrument auto-load by CLOB condition IDs

fixture_groups.product_scope: CLOB book snapshots, fee rates, L2_MBP books, quotes, trades, and public REST market-data requests
Data API trades and positions used for fills, reports, and reconciliation evidence
Public market WebSocket lifecycle for book, price, quote, tick-size, trade, resolved, and new-market messages
covers: market WebSocket connect and subscribe lifecycle
book snapshot and book update messages
trade, tick-size, resolved, and new-market messages

fixture_groups.product_scope: Authenticated user WebSocket order and trade lifecycle messages
covers: order placement, update, match, cancellation, venue cancel, and FOK kill messages

fixture_groups.product_scope: Order submit, cancel, batch cancel, open orders, unknown-submit recovery, and unsupported-order denial evidence
covers: limit and market order submit responses
open order and open order page parsing
cancel, cancel failure, and batch cancel responses
unsupported reduce-only, quote quantity, TIF, and modification boundaries

fixture_groups.product_scope: Fixture-backed authentication headers, L1 EIP-712 signing, L2 credentials, fee math, balance allowance, and precision boundaries
covers: balance allowance with and without collateral allowance
market-buy fee adjustment and dust snap boundaries

scoped_blockers.summary: Polymarket now has a compact Rust fixture manifest for release-gate traceability.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Closed by RADP-023 manifest coverage for Gamma discovery, CLOB public data, Data API reports, WebSocket market/user messages, execution lifecycle, signing, fee, and precision fixture groups.

scoped_blockers.summary: Polymarket is a prediction-market CLOB adapter for BinaryOption instruments, not a generic multi-asset venue.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: fixture evidence is pinned to Gamma/CLOB condition IDs, token IDs, pUSD collateral, and BinaryOption instrument construction.

scoped_blockers.summary: Polymarket market data is explicitly L2_MBP and CLOB-message oriented.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: manifest evidence covers L2_MBP books, quote derivation, trades, tick-size, resolved, and new-market messages, while generic bars and non-L2 book parity remain out of scope.

scoped_blockers.summary: Polymarket execution supports a limited order matrix and explicitly rejects unsupported reduce-only, quote-quantity, TIF, and modification flows.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: fixtures cover limit/market submit, cancel, batch cancel, active order pages, failed submit, server error, and denial boundaries without claiming generic order parity.

scoped_blockers.summary: Polymarket authentication and setup require wallet, L1 EIP-712 signing, L2 API credentials, endpoint, allowance, and rate-limit awareness.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as fixture/mock only: RADP-023 evidence uses checked-in fixtures and mock-server tests, never real private keys, wallets, API credentials, allowances, or live Polymarket calls.

scoped_blockers.summary: Polymarket account, position, fill, reconciliation, and unknown-submit behavior depend on active order pages and Data API pages.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: manifest evidence covers balance allowance, open orders, Data API trades, Data API positions, trade reports, and reconciliation paths.

scoped_blockers.summary: Polymarket fee and precision behavior is venue-specific and must not be treated as generic fee model parity.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: manifest evidence covers fee-rate payloads, Gamma fee schedules, taker commission math, market-buy fee adjustment, and fill dust snap behavior.

scoped_blockers.summary: Optional Polymarket legacy bridge and removed extension surfaces were removed by RREM-018.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Deferred to the Rust-only removal gate because RADP-023 is superseded by RREM-018 removal authorization.
